identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.06] Build the operator attention inbox and intervention workflow

values.task_boundary: Implement only #116 operator attention inbox and intervention workflow; preserve #117 and children as downstream.
deliverables: Observatory inbox projection and action surfaces
Focused runtime and Observatory proof for lifecycle, spoof denial, dedup/rate/expiry, restart/reconnect, and explicit outcomes
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every attention request has stable source identity, reason, correlation, priority, expiry, lifecycle state, and bounded retention metadata.
AC-2: Agents cannot fabricate authority, urgency, or another agent identity.
AC-3: Rate limits, grouping, deduplication, quiet modes, and retention prevent attention flooding.
AC-4: Operator acknowledge, reply, defer, resolve, and refuse outcomes route through governed conversation paths and never imply approval without explicit authority action.
AC-5: Observatory exposes live inbox state with unread/read status, filters, deep links, and notification preferences.
AC-6: Restart and reconnect preserve actionable requests without duplicate notifications.
AC-7: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings; PR CI and terminal finish pass.
